bridge-type.label: Tedee Bridge
bridge-type.description: Tedee Bridge for local communication with Tedee locks.

parameter.name: ip
parameter.label: Bridge IP Address
parameter.description: IP address of the Tedee Bridge.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: HTTP port of the Tedee Bridge.

parameter.name: apiToken
parameter.label: API Token
parameter.description: API token used to authenticate with the Tedee Bridge.

parameter.name: pollInterval
parameter.label: Poll Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds for checking the Tedee Bridge.

bridge-type.label: Tedee Cloud
bridge-type.description: Tedee Cloud connection using a Personal Access Key.

parameter.name: personalAccessKey
parameter.label: Personal Access Key
parameter.description: Personal Access Key used to authenticate with the Tedee Cloud API.

parameter.name: pollInterval
parameter.label: Poll Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds for checking the Tedee Cloud connection.

thing-type.label: Tedee Lock
thing-type.description: Tedee smart lock connected through a Tedee Bridge.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: Numeric ID of the Tedee lock.

parameter.name: pollInterval
parameter.label: Poll Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds for reading the lock status.

channel-type.label: Lock
channel-type.description: Lock or unlock the Tedee lock.

channel-type.label: Lock State
channel-type.description: Current internal state of the Tedee lock.

channel-type.label: Door State
channel-type.description: Current door state reported by the Tedee lock.

channel-type.label: Battery Level
channel-type.description: Battery level of the Tedee lock in percent.

channel-type.label: Charging
channel-type.description: Indicates whether the Tedee lock is charging.

channel-type.label: Jammed
channel-type.description: Indicates whether the Tedee lock is jammed.

channel-type.label: Connected
channel-type.description: Indicates whether the Tedee lock is connected to the Tedee Bridge.

channel-type.label: Action
channel-type.description: Send an action to the Tedee lock.
